prompt: Write a function longest_unique_substring(s: str) -> int that returns the length of the longest substring of s that contains no repeating characters.

refinement_turns.instruction: Refactor the sliding-window logic into clearly named variables so the intent is immediately obvious to a reader.
Replace the set-based membership check with a dict that stores the last-seen index of each character, eliminating the need to shrink the window character-by-character.
Add a PEP 257 docstring and full type annotations without changing any logic.
Ensure the function handles strings containing only whitespace and strings with Unicode characters (e.g., emoji or accented letters) correctly.
Add an early-exit guard: if the string length is 0 or 1, return the length immediately without entering the main loop.
